 Time To Fly Travel Fair 2026: Flight tickets from $258 to over 70 destinations
 Written by Zhen Wei Soh 
 on October 20, 2026 
 Share
 0 shares 
 Pack your luggage, ladies & gentlemen. It’s time to fly ! The Time To Fly Travel Fair 2026 is happening from 23 to 30 October 2026 and features discounts on over 380,000 Singapore Airlines (SIA) and Scoot tickets .
 Curious about which destinations are included in this sale? Keep reading and look out for your favourite cities ! 
 Visit Over 70 Destinations at Lower Prices
 Credit: Pelago 
 During the sale period, more than 200,000 return tickets from SIA will be discounted across Business Class , Premium Economy Class , and Economy Class on flights from Singapore to 78 destinations. 
 Confirmed destinations and discounted round-trip Economy Class tickets include:
 Bangkok from S$258 
 Da Nang from S$258 
 Hangzhou from S$388 
 Taipei from S$388 
 Sydney from S$558 
 London from S$988 
 Los Angeles from S$988 
 Madrid from S$988 
 SIA tickets purchased during this sale will be for travel between 1 January 2027 and 30 September 2027 . For more deals and promo codes , visit SIA’s website on 23 October 2026 , where special credit card offers will also drop.
 Credit: Scoot 
 Another website to watch is Scoot’s Time To Fly page . Customers can look forward to over 180,000 discounted tickets in ScootPlus and Economy Class , from Singapore to 70 destinations . 
 The special fares will only be unveiled on 23 October 2026 , but Scoot has already dropped some teasers. Expect new routes to destinations such as Belitung , Chiang Rai , Guiyang , and Okinawa . 
 Scoot tickets purchased during this sale will be for travel between 9 November 2026 and 15 October 2027 . Bookmark Scoot’s page and check back again on 23 October 2026.
 The Time To Fly Travel Fair promotion will be available online from 23 to 30 October 2026 via SIA and Scoot’s respective websites , mobile applications , and appointed travel agents . 
 3-Day Physical Travel Fair
 Credit: Singapore Airlines Facebook 
 Beyond online sales, Time To Fly will also present itself as a 3-day physical travel fair from 23 to 25 October 2026 at the Suntec Convention Centre . Visiting this physical fair will give you access to exclusive deals from over 30 travel agents and partners .
 This includes 1-for-1 travel deals from Hong Thai Travel , up to S$500 in travel savings from Trip.com , up to 50% off flights, hotels and cruises via Traveloka , and more.
 There will also be giveaways and a grand Lucky Draw you can take part in. Top prizes include SIA Business Class return tickets to Cebu , Hangzhou , and Sydney with hotel accommodation .
 Other daily draw prizes include Scoot vouchers worth up to S$2,000 , KrisShop vouchers worth up to S$800 , and more SIA Business Class return tickets . For more information on what to expect at Time To Fly Travel Fair 2026, click here .
 It’s time to gather your family and friends to plan for your 2027 holidays . May the fastest flight bookers win!
 Time To Fly Travel Fair 2026 
 Scoot | Singapore Airlines | Website 
📍 1 Raffles Boulevard, Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre, Level 4, Halls 401–403, Singapore 039593 (Physical Fair)
🕚 10am–9pm (Physical Fair from 23 to 25 October 2026)
🗓️ 23 to 30 October 2026 (Online Sale)
